says: In next/, JsonSchema.format now prints the settings schema with its own hand-written JSON layout and its own copy of the formatter's line width, 120, so that pnpm format leaves person.json alone. The layout rules and the width live twice: in the repo formatter and its settings, and in this function. Smallest fix: read the width from the formatter's settings, or write the file through the formatter itself.
proof: settings/JsonSchema.ts:62 is const WIDTH = 120 with the comment that it comes from .oxfmtrc.json, and :83 folds an array onto one line by it; .oxfmtrc.json:9 is printWidth: 120; next/apps/fabrika/src/settings-generated.test.ts:30-31 compares the committed files with JsonSchema.format's text.
cost: A change to the formatter's width or to how it folds arrays makes the settings-generated test and pnpm format disagree until this copy is edited by hand.
